description: Phase C3.0 lock-in: counts hard-coded `provider === '<key>'` control-flow branches in the integration orchestrator. The Phase C3.7 commit replaces these branches with a post-ingest hook registry; until then, the count must match this baseline so a new branch cannot slip in unnoticed during decomposition.

matches.context: syncEntities() — calls themeparks-sync.service.syncParkFromThemeParks for platform master-data sync after ingest. Slated for replacement by post-ingest hook registry in C3.7. Line shifted in C3.6 (uns-topic-suggestion extraction).

syncLive() — calls themeparks-sync.service.syncThemeParksLiveOnly for platform live observations after ingest. Slated for replacement by post-ingest hook registry in C3.7. Line shifted in C3.6 (uns-topic-suggestion extraction).

rules.newBranchesNotAllowed: Adding a new `if (provider === '<key>')` branch in the orchestrator (or its successor modules in src/modules/integrations/orchestrator/) requires (a) writing a post-ingest hook in the adapter package and (b) updating this baseline with an explicit reason. Drive-by additions fail the governance gate.
